page.overview:
Who is Eadyth?

Eadyth (pronounced: ee-DITH) is an Aes Sedai of the Blue Ajah.

Her long white hair suggests she is very old for an Aes Sedai, likely well over 200 years old.

Eadyth was the First Selector of the Blue Ajah, as well as a Sitter in the Hall. She was considered one of the most capable Blue in the last one hundred years and was First Selector during this time.

She is one of the Blue Ajah Sitters who present the shawl to Moiraine Damodred and Siuan Sanche when they first become Aes Sedai.
